# Vibe coding prompt system

31 prompts, one file each, in workflow order. Every prompt owns one project file and names the next step. How the system works: [docs/vibe-coding-system.md](../../docs/vibe-coding-system.md).

## Start — set up the project memory (once)

| Prompt | Writes | Next |
|---|---|---|
| ⚡ [Quick Start — new small project (all core files in one chat)](./quick-start.md) | docs/PRD.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md | Plan the Change (no code yet) |
| 🔭 [Vibe Workflow 1/4 — Deep Research (big product)](./research.md) | docs/research.md | Vibe Workflow 2/4 — PRD Generator |
| 📋 [Vibe Workflow 2/4 — PRD Generator](./prd.md) | docs/PRD.md | Vibe Workflow 3/4 — Technical Design → ARCHITECTURE.md |
| 🏛️ [Vibe Workflow 3/4 — Technical Design → ARCHITECTURE.md](./tech-design.md) | docs/ARCHITECTURE.md | Vibe Workflow 4/4 — Agent Setup (AGENTS.md + tool adapters) |
| 🤖 [Vibe Workflow 4/4 — Agent Setup (AGENTS.md + tool adapters)](./agent-setup.md) | AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, tool adapter files | Plan the Change (no code yet) |
| 🧹 [Project Memory Audit (adopt an existing repo / fix doc drift)](./docs-audit.md) | any core file that is missing or wrong (with my approval) | AGENTS.md Keeper (+ Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Antigravity adapters) |
| 🧑‍✈️ [Manager — run several AI agents safely (MANAGER.md)](./manager.md) | MANAGER.md, MEMORY.md, CHANGELOG.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.md | Plan the Change (no code yet) |

## Loop — plan → build → verify → review, one change at a time

| Prompt | Writes | Next |
|---|---|---|
| 📐 [Plan the Change (no code yet)](./plan-change.md) | MEMORY.md | Build One Slice |
| 🏗️ [Build One Slice](./build.md) | source code, tests, MEMORY.md, CHANGELOG.md | Verify It Really Works |
| ✅ [Verify It Really Works](./verify.md) | MEMORY.md | Review the Diff Before Merging |
| 🧐 [Review the Diff Before Merging](./review.md) | (nothing — report only) | Session Handoff (end of session / switch tool) |
| 🔍 [Debug — paste the error](./debug.md) | source code, tests, TROUBLESHOOTING.md, MEMORY.md | Verify It Really Works |
| 🧪 [Write the Tests That Matter](./write-tests.md) | tests | Verify It Really Works |
| ♻️ [Refactor Without Changing Behavior](./refactor.md) | source code, tests, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (only if structure changes) | Verify It Really Works |
| 🎨 [UI Polish Pass](./ui-polish.md) | UI code | Verify It Really Works |
